Concerning Accuracy / Calibration . . . Originally posted March 4, 2025 . . . . Today is day 13 of the current sensor (Libre3)  . . . And also my six month checkup at the VA Clinic in Green Bay, Wisconsin . . . Official bloodwork of glucose was 86,  sensor reading 10 minutes later was 83 . . . Lab A1c reading was 5.7, sensor GMI was 5.7 . . . Both readings certainly close enough for me . . . . . . .

Six months earlier . . . . Today is day 2 of the current sensor (Libre3)  . . . Lab bloodwork (VA  Clinic). . . glucose was 105,  sensor reading 10 minutes later was 110 . . . Lab A1c was 5.8, sensor GMI was 5.7 . . . . . . . . . . 

Six months earlier . . . . Today is day 12 of current sensor . . . . . . Official Bloodwork (VA Clinic) blood glucose of 99, sensor reading 20 minutes later revealed reading of 96 . . . . A1c was 5.9 and sensor GMI reading was 5.8 . . . . .
